1820. Online Shopping Cart using Composite

Medium

Online Shopping Cart using Composite

Problem Statement:
Design an online shopping cart system demonstrating the Composite Design Pattern along with the Strategy Pattern for applying discounts dynamically.

Description:
Abstract Base Class: Item
Virtual function getPrice()

Leaf Class:

Product

Composite Class:

ComboPack (contains multiple Item objects)

Strategy Interface:
DiscountStrategy
Virtual function applyDiscount(double total)

Concrete Strategies:

NoDiscount
PercentageDiscount
FlatDiscount

Requirements:
Use a base class pointer (Item*) to achieve polymorphism.
Total price of ComboPack = sum of all its child Items.
Support nested ComboPacks (a ComboPack can contain other ComboPacks).
Apply discount dynamically using Strategy Pattern.
Add virtual destructor in base class.
Demonstrate polymorphic behavior while calculating total price.

Input Format:
Item Type (Product / Combo)
Discount Type (None / Percentage / Flat)

Output Format:
Final Cart Price after applying discount
